mcp_tools.title: Uat scenario sign off pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a UAT scenario and sign-off record (scope, declared acceptance-criterion rows, declared scenario rows, environment and people declarations, execution declarations, declared defect rows, triage declarations, declared required sign-off role rows, declared sign-off rows, retest declarations, declared totals, red lines) and returns a deterministic UAT_SIGN_OFF_SOUND / UAT_SIGN_OFF_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed criterion-to-scenario coverage, sign-off completeness over the declared required roles and recomputation of the declared totals over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record only; it runs no UAT, executes no scenario and accepts nothing on anyone's behalf.
